name: Medgyesegyháza (Hungary)
description: A vertical white banner charged near the top with the town arms of Medgyesegyháza (a shield of red and green with a white cross fleury and a blue base) below the name MEDGYESEGYHÁZA in black.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.
